answer: Joiners post a 3,000-POA bond into an escrow crystal that cannot thaw until a 12-epoch challenge horizon ends. Any established miner may publish collision proofs (shared TPM quote, reused IP-prefix, cloned receipt chain) during that window; a hit burns the bond and bans the key family. An adversary hoping to forge 60 identities must immobilize 180,000 POA for the whole horizon and keep 60 non-overlapping provenance trails—cost scales with seats, not with scripts.
